transcript: Three ways to cleanse your liver after years of eating junk food. And no, it's not those viral detox drinks or supplements. These are what truly create change. Listen carefully. The last one is often ignored. One, remove the burden. You cannot heal while continuing the damage. Processed food, sugar, alcohol. Each day you keep them, you slow your recovery. Healing begins the moment you stop adding more poison. Two, return to simple foods, greens, bitter vegetables, whole natural meals. Not powders, not quick fixes. Real food supports the body quietly, without force. This is how balance is restored. Three, respect the night. Most people ignore this. The liver repairs itself while you sleep. If you stay awake, stressed, dehydrated, you block your own healing. The body already knows what to do, but it only works when you stop fighting it. Follow the path for more wisdom like this.
